name: VEXI
description: An open-source AI coding agent for developers who prefer the terminal. Features BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) approach, multi-provider support (OpenAI, Anthropic, others), multilingual capabilities, and privacy-friendly workflow. Designed to keep developers in their terminal environment without switching between tools.
community_quotes: Open-source terminal-first agents are where a lot of real developer workflow will shake out. BYOK + provider flexibility is a good default.
What does VEXI do to keep long-running refactors inspectable before changes hit the filesystem?
85 upvotes on Product Hunt with #21 Day Rank
Launched in 2026 with focus on developer privacy and flexibility
